review_candidates.title: Senior Director - Marketing and GTM Messaging
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Product + GTM Partnership You will work daily with Senior Product Management to maintain a tight connection between the market and the product. Product Management owns product direction, requirements, prioritization, and delivery. Together, you will maintain a continuous operating loop: Market → Customer → Product → Message → Demand → Sales → Feedback You will bring customer, prospect, competitive, and sales intelligence into Product Management while translating product capabilities and releases
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Reporting directly to the VP Marketing in the United States, this is a senior, hands-on role combining product marketing, demand generation, positioning, and pipeline development. Product Management owns product direction, requirements, prioritization, and delivery. What We’re Looking For * 8+ years of B2B technology marketing experience.
